title: Nourishing Soft Middle Eastern Lamb Tagine
description: A jammy and pillowy middle eastern dish featuring lamb, perfect for a date night, made with white wine vinegar and cooked in an agave leaf vessel, this high protein friendly meal is sure to impress. The combination of flavors and textures will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the white wine vinegar, olive oil, salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika.
Place the lamb shoulder in the agave leaf vessel and brush the vinegar mixture all over the lamb.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the vessel, scattering them around the lamb.
Add the pitted dates to the vessel, scattering them around the lamb and onion.
Cover the vessel with foil and bake for 2.5 hours.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes, or until the lamb is tender and the dates are jammy.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the lamb and dates with the juices spooned over the top.
